description: One number placed on a labelled axis, so the reader sees where it stands against the reference points the article gives.

label.description: What the number counts, in a few words: "River level at noon".

marks.description: Reference points from the article: a previous value, a threshold, a target. Every mark is an article number.

label.description: What the mark is: "Flood threshold", "Previous high, 2009".

value.description: The reference point, as a plain number.

max.description: Optional right end of the axis, a display choice. Leave it out and the axis fits the value and the marks.

min.description: Optional left end of the axis, a display choice. Leave it out and the axis fits the value and the marks.

unit.description: What the numbers measure: "Metres", "% from the January peak". It is printed after the value, each mark and both axis ends, so no number on the axis reads bare.

value.description: The headline figure, as a plain number: 4.2 for "4.2 m", -20 for "down 20%".

title: Scale
